scope: Audit of 79 EncarRus no-match listing IDs. Cumulative draft candidate ledger now contains 53 listing IDs across 44 configurations; 26 IDs remain outside the manifest. No record is approved for calculation or publication.
sourcePolicy: Official manufacturer/Korea-market dealer specifications are preferred; Drom and other catalogues are secondary-source candidates. Keep only matches aligned to the run's model/year/engine/fuel/trim. All are preliminary evidence, not legal or TKS confirmation.

countingNote: This ledger accounts for all 79 run-scoped no-match listing IDs: 14 from v1 plus 39 additional unique candidate listings are represented in the cumulative draft manifest (53 IDs, 44 configurations). The remaining 26 are all explicitly held: 17 prior hybrid/identity/source-conflict holds plus 7 newly classified hybrid/mild-hybrid IDs, 1 Encar category/detail identity conflict, and 1 V220 CDI displacement conflict. No remaining ID is counted as a confirmed ICE power match. All imported rules remain draft/unapproved; none is approved for TKS calculation or publication.
